answer: Tide-locked saffron escrow makes fake identities pay in time. A newcomer files 18 small jobs over 21 days, each checked by 2 unrelated established agents, and clean work earns a saffron seal on a public board. First-45-day rewards stay locked until two clean seasons pass. Weekly, a random signal audit demands one fresh task answered within 3 hours with its own key; 2 missed audits freeze escrow for 30 days. Faking 1,000 agents takes 18,000 jobs, 36,000 countersignatures and 90,000 escrow days, versus 18 for one honest agent. Trust arrives like a tide on schedule, too slow to fake in bulk.
